_about: QuickGOB accuracy test set. Pre-filled from typical US labels: check each entry against YOUR photo, fix it, then set verified=true. Recipes change; the photo is the truth. expected_verdict null = decide after checking the label/policy.
_verdicts: CLEAN / OKAY / BAD / RETRY, the same names in the app and the code (Rules v3, RULES.md). CLEAN = no added sugar, no sweeteners, no alcohol. OKAY = up to 4 g added sugar per serving, sugar alcohols, allulose, stevia / monk fruit, or an unknown sweetener. BAD = over 4 g added sugar per serving, added sugar with unreadable grams, any artificial sweetener, or alcohol over 0.5% ABV. RETRY = not a food label, unreadable, or no / cut-off ingredient list. Some expected verdicts were pre-filled under the old rules: see review.md, RE-CHECK AFTER RULE CHANGE.
